==Biography==
'''Robo''' played for [[INTZ Red]] during some tournaments of the [[Brazilian Challenger Circuit/2015 Season/Split 1|2015 Brazilian Challenger Circuit Split 1]] (often changing places with {{bl|Caos (Jonas Vriesman)|Caos}}) and the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2 Promotion|2015 CBLOL Split 2 Promotion]]. Due to his studies, Robo couldn't completely focus on CBLOL, so the team chose Caos as the starting top laner for the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2|2015 CBLOL Split 2]] and allowed Robo to play for a Challenger Circuit team. In June he joined [[JAYOB e-Sports]] as AD carry, playing at the [[Brasil Mega Arena/Rio 2015|BRMA Rio 2015]] and the [[Brazilian Challenger Circuit/2015 Season/Split 2/Go4LoL May|Go4LoL Monthly Final - May 2015]]. He was called back by INTZ Red to play at Week 5 of CBLOL Split 2, becoming ineligible to play for a Challenger Circuit team and leaving JAYOB in the process.

== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Originally a top laner, joined [[JAYOB e-Sports]] as AD carry.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Ekko}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* His favourite Champions are {{ci|Tristana}}, {{ci|Darius}} and {{ci|Camille}}.
* Became famous during MSI 2021 for a campaign in Brazil with the hashtag "RobsDay" that became a worldwide trending topic on Twitter being reproduced by several people including a famous priest in Brazil.<ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/lol-robsday-viraliza-e-ate-padre-fabio-de-melo-entra-na-brincadeira LoL: “RobsDay” viraliza e até Padre Fábio de Melo entra na brincadeira] ''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
* After a good [[2021 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2021]], he and his teammate [[tinowns]] allegedly received offers from [[LEC]] teams and its sisters teams, but negotiations didn't go through. Since then, it became a joke in the Brazilian community, with them sometimes being called "'''LEC players'''".
* Got featured with his "É o Robs" photo in a graffiti in the [[Worlds 2021]] theme music video, '''Burn it All Down'''. <ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/worlds-2021-brtt-fnb-gruntar-schaeppi-sao-homenageados-em-clipe-da-musica-tema/ Worlds 2021: brTT, Robo, FNB, Gruntar e Schaeppi ganham referências no clipe da música tema]''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
* His KR ID refers to a microwave, as do the [[Ceos]] and [[Tinowns]] IDs refer to other home appliances.
* He once spoke in [[Baiano]]'s [[Ilha das Lendas|Depois do Crime]] that during his time in LOUD he had won every Finals against [[Wizer]] because he knew how to read every move he makes and uses that to predict [[Cariok]]'s moves.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7eqPDo4T6Ng O ROBO É O PAI DO WIZER NO CBLOL (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
|-|
Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* Known in Brazil for the phrase "É o Robs! IRIRIRIRI!". He say it when he makes a good play or for celebrating a victory. The word "Robs" makes refearance to his nickname, Robo. This turned to a Brazilian gag.
* He said in a interview that the fact that [[paiN Gaming]] won a game despite losing the series against [[LOUD]] by 3-1 in the [[CBLOL 2023 Split 2 Playoffs|CBLOL 2023 Split 2 Playoffs Finals]] was due to him being unfocused with the fact there would be a show of the Brazilian rapper [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matuê Matuê] after the series.<ref>[https://twitter.com/CBLOL/status/1775991735329439874 CBLOL's Tweet]</ref>
|-|
Notable Achievements=
=== Notable Achievements ===
* Since the start of his career in the [[CBLOL 2015 Split 2|CBLOL 2015]], he almost always qualify for playoffs (with the sole exception being the [[CBLOL/2022 Season/Split 1|first split of 2022]] when he did not qualify for playoffs), with a total of 16 playoffs and 9 finals played.
* He is the player with the most titles in CBLOL history, surpassing even [[brTT]] with seven domestic titles as of [[CBLOL 2024 Split 1 Playoffs|CBLOL 2024 Split 1]].
|-|
Statistics=
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1500 kills in the CBLOL on June 28th, 2024.
** The 3rd player to reach 1500 kills in the CBLOL, after [[micaO]] and [[Tinowns]].
** His 1500th kill was on [[Fluxo]]'s jungler, [[Shini]].
|-|
Awards=
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x CBLOL Awards Best Toplaner (2018, 2022, 2023)
* 1x CBLOL Awards Best Play (2023)
* 1x Best League of Legends Athlete (Premio eSports Brasil 2023)
* 1x CBLOL 1st All-Pro Team (2024 Split 1)
* 1x LTA South 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (2025 Split 3)
* 1x CBLOL Finals MVP (Spring 2024)
